theme: An open day, with tomorrow's recruiter call and two booking windows to get ahead of.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan — nothing scheduled at all. The weight sits on tomorrow's recruiter call and a couple of booking deadlines closing this week.

needsAttention.title: Decide your asks for tomorrow's Amin call
needsAttention.detail: Your recruiter call with Amin Noorani is 9:30 AM tomorrow on Teams. Worth settling tonight which board targets, sectors and geographies you want him working, so the half hour is yours to steer.

needsAttention.title: December trip for the girls books by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: The Mike + Dan board has the Dec 13 – Jan 2 trip (all four girls) set to book by tomorrow. Holiday inventory for six across three weeks is the thinnest of the year, and the shortlist was due Sept 30.

needsAttention.title: Send ICGN your planning-call availability
needsAttention.detail: ICGN is lining up the Plenary 7 planning call and collecting everyone's availability; Rachit has replied he is free next week 12–1 PM UK. As the session's moderator, your times are still outstanding.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Still open on the board at p1, flagged book-this-week: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, before the holiday inventory in that market sells out.

flagged.title: Disney+ flagged a new login
flagged.detail: Two new-login notices came in overnight to both your addresses — a quick glance to confirm it was you.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley savings needs funding
flagged.detail: A final-reminder notice to fund your new Signature Savings account, plus a separate note about adding beneficiaries.

flagged.title: The Stewardship Digest, October issue
flagged.detail: The latest governance read landed this morning — your field, worth skimming when there's a gap.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and newsletters — Airbnb, Mattress Firm, SiriusXM, Dermstore, Nextdoor and a couple of local papers.

recipe.title: Translucent Apple Tart
recipe.why: Autumn apples are at their peak now, and this tart keeps them the star.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Drive the Pathfinder down to St Pete
Order Portland bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar before noon — the day starts entirely yours.
Still open straight through; a rare uninterrupted block to spend on the board search.
A quiet close to a clear day, with a busier one waiting at 9:30 tomorrow.
